name: PlainScam
subtitle: Recognize scams. Stay safe.
shortDescription: 1,100+ free & Pro guides plus real on-device tools — live camera scam scanner, risk analyzer, cybersecurity checks. Cites real government sources.
longDescription:
Scams are engineered to move fast and feel urgent. PlainScam slows that down — plain-language, offline-first education and real on-device tools, including live camera scanning and cybersecurity checks, to recognize and stop scams before they cost you.

### What's Inside
35 modules and 1,139 guides and tools covering the scams that actually target people every day: phone and robocall scams, SMS/text scams, email and phishing, tech-support scams, government and tax impersonation, delivery and package scams, charity scams, elder-targeted scams, romance scams, crypto and investment fraud, banking and payment fraud, and business-fraud schemes like fake job offers and invoice fraud.

### Cited to Real Authorities
Every module lists the real government agencies and organizations its guidance is consistent with — the FTC, FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center, CISA, IRS, SSA, CFPB, SEC, FINRA, UNODC, INTERPOL, and more depending on topic. Tap any source right from a guide to read it directly, in an in-app browser that keeps you right where you left off.

### Real Tools, Not Just Articles
- Live Scam Scanner: point your camera at a pop-up, letter, check, or QR code and see red flags highlighted live, on-device
- Message Risk Analyzer: paste any text, email, or call description and get an instant risk score with the exact red flags highlighted
- Link Safety Checker: catches lookalike domains and disguised-subdomain tricks before you ever tap a link
- Caller/Number Verifier: checks a number's digit pattern for spoofing red flags and keeps your own list of verified real numbers
- Cyber Security tools: see in real time if your screen is being recorded or mirrored, check for apps showing patterns seen in real banking-trojan malware, and a guided check for hidden tracking apps
- A "too good to be true" investment-return calculator
- A live-pressure decision tree, quizzes, interactive checklists, and red-flag scorers
- A private personal log, a shareable red-flags card, an in-call countdown timer, reminders, and a home-screen widget

### Built for Accessibility
Full VoiceOver support, Dynamic Type plus an independent in-app text size control, Dyslexia-Friendly Text, Reduce Motion, a Color-Blind-Safe Palette, and a High Contrast Mode.

### Your Privacy
Whether you're protecting yourself or helping an older parent or relative stay safe, PlainScam gives you the same pattern-recognition skills scam investigators use — explained plainly, available offline, and ready the moment you need them.
